description: This file provides utility functions for handling OpenCL error codes, creating buffers, sub-buffers, and 2D images within the TensorFlow Lite GPU delegate for OpenCL. It includes functions for error code to string conversion, checking OpenCL support, and resource management via creation functions.
external_methods: // Note: This is likely defined elsewhere in the library

methods.name: std::string CLErrorCodeToString(cl_int error_code)
methods.description: Converts OpenCL error codes to human-readable strings.

methods.name: bool OpenCLSupported()
methods.description: Checks if OpenCL is supported on the current platform.

methods.name: absl::Status CreateCLBuffer(cl_context context,int size_in_bytes,bool read_only,void * data,cl_mem * result)
methods.description: Creates an OpenCL buffer with specified size and flags, optionally copying host data.

methods.name: absl::Status CreateCLSubBuffer(cl_context context,cl_mem parent,size_t origin_in_bytes,size_t size_in_bytes,bool read_only,cl_mem * result)
methods.description: Creates a sub-buffer within an existing OpenCL buffer.

methods.name: absl::Status CreateRGBAImage2D(cl_context context,int width,int height,cl_channel_type channel_type,void * data,cl_mem * result)
methods.description: Creates a 2D RGBA image in OpenCL with specified dimensions and data.

methods.name: int ChannelTypeToSizeInBytes(cl_channel_type type)
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes for a given OpenCL channel type.

calls: // Presumed to be part of the OpenCL utility functions

ctags.name: CreateCLSubBuffer
ctags.signature: (cl_context context,cl_mem parent,size_t origin_in_bytes,size_t size_in_bytes,bool read_only,cl_mem * result)

ctags.name: CreateRGBAImage2D
ctags.pattern: /^absl::Status CreateRGBAImage2D(cl_context context, int width, int height,$/
ctags.signature: (cl_context context,int width,int height,cl_channel_type channel_type,void * data,cl_mem * result)
